Town of Gananoque re: Request for Endorsement of Declaration Against Religious Violence
1.
Town of Gananoque - Request for Endorsement - Declaration Against Religious Violence - October 14, 2026.pdf
Recommendation:
WHEREAS the Town of Gananoque has issued a Declaration Against Religious Violence in response to incidents of religiously motivated violence and intimidation across Canada;
AND WHEREAS the Township of Blandford-Blenheim recognizes the fundamental rights of all individuals to equality, dignity, freedom of religion, and the ability to live and worship without fear of violence or discrimination;
AND WHEREAS municipalities play an important role in fostering inclusive, respectful, and welcoming communities where diversity is valued and all residents feel safe and supported;
NOW THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Council of the Township of Blandford-Blenheim hereby endorses the Town of Gananoque's Declaration Against Religious Violence, dated October 7, 2026, and affirms its commitment to promoting tolerance, mutual respect, understanding, and the rejection of hatred, violence, and intimidation in all forms;
AND FURTHER THAT a copy of this resolution be forwarded to the Town of Gananoque and the Honourable Graham McGregor, Minister of Citizenship and Multiculturalism.
